up: From the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727045, find all compounds that are reported in it. For each compound, retrieve its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Ensure each compound appears only once in the results. Do not filter by activity type, value, or units; simply include any compound that has an activity record associated with that document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727045';
